audit.whatIsWrong: The level chart gave Levels 2, 3, 4-5 and Level 6 to Akali/Skill while the accompanying whys describe Kled winning every one of them ('short-trade her here before she can Shroud', 'a non-Shrouded Akali has no stat-check answer', 'You out-trade a pre-item Akali'). Level 6 was 'Skill' in both layers while its why describes her R swinging the fight.
audit.why: Packet levelChart reads Kled,Kled,Kled,Kled,Akali,Akali,Kled and the matchup win rate is 56.88% over 589 games. Kled's mounted stats plus W's four attacks beat a pre-Shroud, pre-item Akali; her R at 6 is the flip.
audit.corrected: Stages 2, 3 and 4-5 flipped to Kled in both layers with ratings raised to 7/10, 7/10, 6/10; Level 6 flipped to Akali in both layers so the side matches its own why.

audit.why: spikes[] already order correctly: Kled at 2-3, Akali at 6 and at 2+ items. Twilight Shroud's 20/19/18/17/16s cooldown was the one missing number and is now stated.
audit.corrected: dosFull[0].d now carries the 20s rank-1 Twilight Shroud cooldown as the concrete bait-and-commit window.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two interactions were stated vaguely or wrongly. 'Untargetable inside it' understates Twilight Shroud — Riot's text says she is invisible AND unable to be selected by spells or attacks, which is why Kled's Q trap and E dash whiff. And the page never mentioned Assassin's Mark, whose trigger is Akali LEAVING the ring, not entering it.
audit.why: Kit text: Twilight Shroud makes her unselectable, so Bear Trap on a Rope (Q, a projectile) and Kled's E target-dash both fail. Assassin's Mark: 'Dealing spell damage to a champion creates a ring of energy around them. Exiting that ring empowers Akali's next Attack with bonus range and damage' — the tell is her stepping out, which is exactly the wind-up the missing-interactions entry flags.
audit.corrected: dontsFull[0].d states the unselectable-so-Q-and-E-whiff interaction; dontsFull[2].d states the Assassin's Mark step-out tell with bonus range; wants.foe[1] uses real ability names.

audit.why: Twilight Shroud is 20/19/18/17/16s — long enough that baiting it hands Kled a real all-in window; Perfect Execution is 120/90/60s.
audit.corrected: 20s stated in dosFull[0].d; Perfect Execution's execute recast named in dontsFull[1].d as the reason to build MR before 6.

edits.before: Untargetable inside it. Fight when down. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Twilight Shroud is 20s at rank 1; she is unselectable inside — commit after.

edits.before: That is Akali's favourite window — refuse it and half his win condition is gone.
edits.after: She is unselectable inside Twilight Shroud, so your Q and E whiff — hold the combo.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Perfect Execution's recast executes — buy MR before you fight 6.

edits.before: Giving away the dismount for free — mounted HP is a resource; spending it on poke instead of all-ins loses the lane.
edits.after: Assassin's Mark rings you — her step OUT of the ring empowers her next auto with bonus range. That step is your cue.

edits.before: Poke with E shuriken and auto-resets to chip Skaarl's mount health from range
edits.after: Poke with Shuriken Flip and Assassin's Mark autos to chip Skaarl's health

notes: Both layers already agreed on every chart row before this audit, so all four flips are proposed as matched pairs. Akali's Q Five Point Strike has a 1.5s cooldown and is energy-gated (110/100/90/80/70), not cooldown-gated — the page's 'energy poke' framing is correct and was left alone. Assassin's Mark triggers on Akali exiting the ring, not on her entering it; the previous text never described it at all rather than describing it wrongly.
